name: Voice chat ducking
author: Voltage
description: Lowers (or pauses) the music while people talk in Discord, Legcord, TeamSpeak, Mumble or any app you add, and brings it back once they stop. Its panel shows a live meter.

settings.label: Starts at
settings.help: How loud a voice must be to lower the music. Sensitive also reacts to quiet speakers; Loud voices only ignores background noise and soft notification sounds. The panel shows where the line is.

settings.label: Reacts after
settings.help: How long a voice must last before the music drops (longer = fewer dips for short sounds).

settings.label: Comes back after
settings.help: How long it must be quiet before the music comes back (longer = no pumping between sentences).

settings.label: Listen to
options: All voice apps (also TeamSpeak, Mumble, Guilded)

settings.label: Also listen to
settings.help: Program names (as in Task Manager > Details), separated by commas: Teams, Zoom, Slack, WhatsApp, a game's own voice chat.
